rebate_estimate_check.note: the venue rounds per PRINT (a 5.10 fill printed as 3.72 + 1.38 credits 0.01, the whole-fill estimate says 0.02); the estimate is an upper bound at this size

limits: derived from EXECUTED TRADES on the public activity feed: a fill is not a quote
concurrency here is FILL concurrency, a lower bound on quoting concurrency
'unknown' maker_taker is outside takerOnly coverage and is never treated as maker
cap in ACTION UNITS = multiples of the window's own median BUY notional; R4's cap is 1 unit
refusal rule identical to R4: exposure-increasing fills above the cap are refused, exposure-reducing fills always allowed
L5's behaviour after a refused fill is unknowable; later fills are kept as they were (same simplification as the R3L counterfactual)
incentive dollars ESTIMATED at the published maker rate, cent-rounded per fill; checked against the venue's R4 credits
